message: エニグマ

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mornin'!」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, take this.」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「A lunch made by a loving wife.」

name: Synn
message: 「A l-loving wife!? Wh-wh-what are you talking about!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-wh-who's a wife, a newlywed wife!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I didn't go as far as saying newlywed.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahem. Anyway, it's red bean rice inside.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What, that legendary red bean rice! Written with 'red' and 'rice' for festive days--though at my house it doesn't even appear then! By the way, Jupiter's is the Great Red Spot!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Calm down.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You said something so awful yesterday, so I made it.」

name: Synn
message: 「This hefty weight... guhhhh! You're amazing, Nanaka! You're a goddess!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-no, it's not that big a deal...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Just as expected of Soba. Trying to tame Synn-sama by feeding him, eh? Though that's a roundabout way to sneak into his bed--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, well, you know. Sengen'in-sensei actually came by my house yesterday.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She said it was just a home visit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though she's not even our homeroom teacher?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't she just dedicated to her job? Actually, several people in our class have had one too.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Come to think of it, I have heard about that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She pointed out all sorts of flaws in how I solve problems and even gave me extra assignments. Aah, I'm beat.」

name: Synn
message: 「Good work today.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Dad didn't seem to like her very much. Sensei Sengen'in, I mean.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh yeah?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He even told me to watch out for that teacher.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's rare for your easygoing dad to say something like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Morning!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mornin'~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Mornin'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Morning, Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mornin'--」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, wait up, Azel!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... She ran off on us again today.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You two sure keep at it~ You're the only ones who still talk to Azel-chan, Synn-kun and Nana-chan~」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, patrols are canceled starting today. Do your best preparing for the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehh!? What's that supposed to mean, Big Sis!」

name: Synn
message: 「You called us out here all of a sudden, so I have no idea what you mean by 'And so'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm used to it by now. Her being abrupt is nothing new.」

name: Helena
message: 「According to my secret intelligence network, the suspicious person won't be showing up at the academy anymore.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even if you say so, Chairwoman, I cannot accept that without any basis.」

name: Helena
message: 「A secret is a secret, so it's a se-cret.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's what they call 'secrecy is the nose'! It was written in my guidebook.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A proper maiden blows her nose in secret, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't accept this either.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's rare for the two of you to agree.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How shameless. Blowing your nose in front of others is embarrassing.」

name: Synn
message: 「That thing that appeared after we fought Pasta the night before last was clearly a powerful Demon.」
I remember how Nanaka was trembling.

name: Synn
message: 「With something like that prowling around, we can't stop patrolling now.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. You wouldn't understand since you weren't there, Sis.」

name: Misa
message: 「At the very least, we have to uncover its identity.」

name: Helena
message: 「It was Sengen'in-sensei.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you bringing up our teacher's name right now.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm saying that one of the presences you encountered was Ms. Kiyora Sengen'in.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Sengen'in-sensei's real name is Soltia. She was one of the Seven Demon Generals.」

name: Misa
message: 「Just like Eauderourke and Pasta...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, she wasn't that big of a deal for a Demon General, right? Ahaha.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you really think that, Soba, you're gonna get yourself killed.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm shocked... She was such a serious, good teacher who explained things so well...」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san, how do you know about--ah, never mind, don't tell me.」
It's probably her secret information network anyway.

name: Ria
message: 「Did you maybe know from the very beginning?」

name: Helena
message: 「I wouldn't have hired her if I knew, would I? Use some common sense.」
Suspicious.

name: Helena
message: 「Aahn. Everyone is suspecting me♪ Helena is so sad!」

name: Misa
message: 「We should interrogate Sengen'in-sensei! And make her confess their scheme!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To make her spill the beans, it's gotta be torture!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if she is a Demon General, torture is no good.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We'll make her solve a mountain of math problems!」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's a math teacher, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mumu. Impressive as expected of a Demon General, that even the ultimate torture doesn't work on her.」

name: Helena
message: 「Whatever we do, first we have to secure her in custody, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As we are right now... it's impossible...」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, we can't just leave her running free any longer!」

name: Helena
message: 「You don't need to worry about that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「Because this was sitting on Sengen'in-sensei's desk this morning.」

name: Everyone
message: 「A resignation letter!?」

name: Ria
message: 「So much for 'secret intelligence.'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When she came for a home visit yesterday, she didn't say anything like that at all.」

name: Helena
message: 「To Nanaka-chan's place?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm. And what did she do?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She suddenly gave me assignments. A whole bunch of them.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How suspicious! That's definitely a cipher. The XYZ Files!」

name: Misa
message: 「By assignments, you mean math?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be... if you read it, you get brainwashed or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. You didn't feel anything weird when you read it, did you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, it's nothing to get so worried over, I mean, I haven't even opened it yet.」

name: Helena
message: 「If she had that kind of power, you'd all be brainwashed by now.」

name: Ria
message: 「Now that you mention it, that's true.」

name: Helena
message: 「Nanaka-chan. Let me see that assignment.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes! Here you go!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehehe, looks like I'll get out of doing my assignment.」

name: Helena
message: 「Since she's disappeared, there's no more patrol starting today! Fair enough?」

name: Helena
message: 「There's less than a month until the Holy Night Festival, anyway. It's high time we stopped.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why do you suppose she quit so suddenly?」

name: Helena
message: 「Demons are whimsical creatures, so maybe she just wanted to try being a teacher.」

name: Ria
message: 「I can't accept a reason like that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see, so even with enough intelligence to be a teacher, she's still a Demon at the end of the day.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're actually convinced by that......」

name: Synn
message: 「Assuming one of the presences was Sengen'in-sensei, what was the other one?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right, there were two presences.」

name: Ria
message: 「A Demon General, maybe?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It felt even stronger than Sengen'in-sensei......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Speaking of mysterious entities of unknown power, that would have to be the Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「*flinch*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So that was the Demon Lord...... Something that incredible......」
I was probably the only one who noticed, but Nanaka was trembling.
She was terrified of the Demon Lord.

name: Helena
message: 「It wasn't the Demon Lord.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... even though they were that incredible...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then... is it Bylous?」

name: Helena
message: 「Probably.」
Soltia. Bylous.
We can't beat either of them.
At least not yet.

name: Nanaka
message: 「The Demon Lord is... even stronger than that...」
If I were to tell Nanaka, who's this terrified, that I'm the Demon Lord...

name: Misa
message: 「Why would even Bylous appear?」

name: Helena
message: 「Just on a whim, probably.」
